title: The Descent of Divine Truth Through Ordered Degrees
summary: Eight complementary frames for the descent of Divine Truth into the cosmos: the Ten Chariots by which Jesus the Son clothes himself for descent; the Five Mysteries by which the First Man goes out and returns; the Twelve Aeons reproduced in the spiritual man as members; the chain of origins tracing every good back to its divine source; the Five Foundational Sayings that establish the Mind of Light; the Five Drawers-Upward as the architecture of resurrection; Death's Five Pourings as the inverse counterpart of descent; and the Twelve Greatnesses by which the divine reach extends to Adam. Each teaching shows the same downward motion under a different correspondential figure.
organizing_principle: Multiple complementary patterns of accommodation — chariots, mysteries, aeons, sayings, awakeners, pourings, greatnesses — each showing the descent of Divine Truth through its proper figure. The numerical patterns (Ten, Five, Twelve) recur as the discrete-degree structures of accommodation.
